name: BlankTB Portal Backend
author: BlankTheDeer
description: FastAPI-powered backend for BlankTB Portal (gba.blanktb.net) with MongoDB integration, Discord alerts, and status management.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /mnt/server

echo "Installing BlankTB Portal Backend..."

if [ -z "${GITHUB_PAT}" ]; then
  echo "❌ Missing GITHUB_PAT variable! Please add it in your server variables."
  exit 1
fi

echo "📦 Cloning backend repository..."
rm -rf gba || true
GIT_REPO="github.com/BlankTheDeer/gba.git"
git clone https://${GITHUB_PAT}@${GIT_REPO} gba --branch dev --single-branch

cd gba/backend

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

pip install --upgrade pip
if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
  pip install -r requirements.txt
else
  pip install fastapi uvicorn motor aiohttp python-dotenv psutil
fi

chmod +x startup.sh

echo "✅ Installation complete!"

variables.name: GITHUB_PAT
variables.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (read-only, required for private repo clone)

variables.name: MONGO_URI
variables.description: MongoDB connection URI used by the backend

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.description: Public domain for the portal frontend

variables.name: DISCORD_ALERT_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook URL for backend alerts

variables.name: DISCORD_UPTIME_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook URL for uptime summary reports

variables.name: RECAPTCHA_SECRET
variables.description: Google reCAPTCHA secret key for backend verification

variables.name: MAIL_SERVER
variables.description: Mail server hostname for outbound emails

variables.name: MAIL_PASS
variables.description: Mail account password or app password
